test_protocol.title: One link per product, before scaling
steps: 1. Sign in to Associates Central and open Account Settings; confirm the tracking ID shopnow047c-20 is listed and active for the account and note which marketplace it belongs to.

2. From SiteStripe or the link builder, generate one tagged link per product for the three ASINs (B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH) and compare each generated URL with the special_link_url published here.
3. Click each of the three published Special Links once, from this site, and confirm the destination page loads the intended ASIN's listing.

4. After 24-48 hours, check the Associates Central report (Today's Earnings / Items dispatched) for clicks attributed to those three clicks; the tag is confirmed end-to-end only when the report shows them.

5. Record the result in data/associates.json (registered_and_active and test_status fields) with the date, then scale to the remaining links. If the report shows no attribution, stop and re-check the tag before any further publishing.
test_protocol.source_ref: Associates Central (account settings and reports; sign-in required)
test_protocol.rule_source_ref: Participation Requirements 2(b) (Special Links and tag format)
